sentences.text:
The petitioner is the third accused in Crime No.321/2024 of the Alakode Police Station, Kannur,
which is registered against the accused (three in number), for allegedly committing the offence punishable under Section 498A r/w Section 34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
Subsequently, the offence under Section 304B of the IPC was incorporated by the Investigating Officer.

3. Heard; Sri.V.T.Madhavanunni, the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and Sri.C.S.Hrithwik, the learned Public Prosecutor.
4.

The learned Public Prosecutor, on instructions, submitted that even though the petitioner was arrayed as BAIL APPL. NO. 4450 OF 2024 the third accused in the crime, the Investigating Officer has deleted the petitioner from the array of accused.
Therefore, the petitioner is no longer an accused in the above crime.
In the light of the above submission, the bail application is closed.

Sd/-
